sentences.cs: Pavel se v pondělí ráno probudil a cítil se špatně.
sentences.en: On Monday morning Pavel woke up and felt unwell.

sentences.cs: Bolela ho hlava a měl teplotu.
sentences.en: His head hurt and he had a temperature.

sentences.cs: Zavolal do práce a řekl, že nepřijde.
sentences.en: He called work and said that he would not come.

sentences.cs: Potom si udělal termín u doktorky.
sentences.en: Then he made an appointment with the doctor.

sentences.cs: V čekárně seděl skoro půl hodiny.
sentences.en: He sat in the waiting room for almost half an hour.

sentences.cs: Doktorka se ho zeptala, co ho bolí.
sentences.en: The doctor asked him what was hurting.

sentences.cs: „Bolí mě hlava a v noci jsem nemohl spát,“ odpověděl Pavel.
sentences.en: "My head hurts and I could not sleep at night," Pavel answered.

sentences.cs: Doktorka mu změřila teplotu a poslechla plíce.
sentences.en: The doctor took his temperature and listened to his lungs.
"You have the flu," she said, "nothing serious."
She wrote him a prescription for medicine.

sentences.cs: „Musíte zůstat doma tři dny a hodně pít.“
sentences.en: "You must stay at home for three days and drink plenty."

sentences.cs: Pavel šel do lékárny vedle ordinace.
sentences.en: Pavel went to the pharmacy next to the surgery.

sentences.cs: Lékárnice mu dala léky a čaj s medem.
sentences.en: The pharmacist gave him medicine and tea with honey.

sentences.cs: Doma si lehl do postele a spal celé odpoledne.
sentences.en: At home he lay down in bed and slept the whole afternoon.

sentences.cs: Ve středu se cítil mnohem lépe.
sentences.en: On Wednesday he felt much better.

sentences.cs: Ve čtvrtek už mohl jít zase do práce.
sentences.en: On Thursday he could already go back to work.
